[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Sager''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] serving in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition]] along with Republic forces under [[Satele Shan]]. There, Sager asked a fellow Coalition member to assist his men in eliminating local predatory wildlife such as the bloodthirsty [[Lurker/Legends|Lurkers]], in Yavin 4's [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

Sergeant Sager appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
